UHD  vs  UHD Hybrid








Quote

The hybrid is made with the AviSynth AutoOverlay plugin.
Sources: GBR and SPA editions of the new 4K HDR remaster, partially UHD of the first remaster, plus two WEB-DL open matte 2K sources.
The new remaster, unlike the old one, does not have oversharpening and is more pleasant in color.
The Dolby Vision layer from the GBR edition is adapted for open matte and converted to DV Profile 8.1 and integrated into the HEVC stream.
